evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Wales: Britannia secunda, Cambria, Cambro-Britannia
terms.comment: A country takes a preposition: in Cambriam (to), in Cambriā (in), ē Cambriā (from).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
